BillsGrandpaIntroText:
Hm? You know BILL?
He's my grandson.

He's in JOHTO. He
does something

with PCs, so I'm
house-sitting.
BillsGrandpaAskToSeeMonText:
If you have that
#MON, may I see it, please?
BillsGrandpaExcitedToSeeText:
You will show me?
How good of you!
BillsGrandpaYouDontHaveItTextText:
You don't have it?
That's too bad…
BillsGrandpaShownPokemonText:
Ah, so that is
@?

Isn't it cute!
That's so kind of you.
BillsGrandpaTokenOfAppreciationText:
Thanks!

This is a token of
my appreciation.
BillsGrandpaShownAllThePokemonText:
Thanks for showing
me so many cute #MON.

I really enjoyed
myself. I'm glad

I've lived such a
long life.
BillsGrandpaWrongPokemonText:
Hm?

That's not the
#MON that I was told about.
BillsGrandpaLickitungText:
My grandson BILL
told me about a

#MON that has a
long tongue.
BillsGrandpaOddishText:
Ah, my grandson
mentioned a round,

green #MON that
has leaves growing on its head.
BillsGrandpaStaryuText:
Do you know of a
sea #MON that

has a red sphere
in its body?

You know, the one
that's shaped like a star?

I heard that it
appears at night.

I would surely
like to see it.
BillsGrandpaGrowlitheText:
BILL told me about
a #MON that is

very loyal to its
trainer.

It's supposed to
ROAR well.
BillsGrandpaVulpixText:
I heard about a
cute #MON that has six tails.

I would love to
hug a cute #MON like that.
BillsGrandpaPichuText:
Do you know that
hugely popular #MON?

The #MON that
has a yellow body and red cheeks.

I would love to
see what it looks

like before it
evolves.
